assertions.description: The ::interest-button pseudo-element selector parses (selector() in @supports / CSS.supports). This proves parsing only. Chromium parses it even when the box is never generated.
HTMLButtonElement.prototype has the interestForElement IDL attribute from the parent Interest Invokers feature, which is the explainer's feature-detect for the originating-element contract.
With content set, a valid interest source (<a href interestfor> whose target exists) generates an ::interest-button box: its used width resolves to pixels instead of 'auto'.
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '.cf-ib-a::interest-button{content:"i"}'; const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-target-a'; t.popover = 'hint'; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; a.className = 'cf-ib-a'; a.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-target-a'); a.textContent = 'x'; document.head.append(s); document.body.append(t, a); const w = getComputedStyle(a, '::interest-button').width; s.remove(); t.remove(); a.remove(); return /px$/.test(w); })()

assertions.description: The UA stylesheet sets no content, so the box exists only when the author sets content. It is generated with content:"i" and not generated without content on an otherwise identical valid interest source.
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '.cf-ib-on::interest-button{content:"i"}'; const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-target-b'; t.popover = 'hint'; const mk = (c) => { const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; if (c) a.className = c; a.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-target-b'); a.textContent = 'x'; return a; }; const on = mk('cf-ib-on'); const off = mk(''); document.head.append(s); document.body.append(t, on, off); const g = (e) => /px$/.test(getComputedStyle(e, '::interest-button').width); const r = g(on) && !g(off); s.remove(); t.remove(); on.remove(); off.remove(); return r; })()

assertions.description: The box exists only on valid interest sources. With the same content rule, it is generated for a valid <a href interestfor> and NOT for an element without interestfor, an interestfor whose id is missing, an <a> without href, or a disabled <button>.
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '.cf-ib-v::interest-button{content:"i"}'; const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-target-c'; t.popover = 'hint'; const mk = (tag, attrs) => { const e = document.createElement(tag); e.className = 'cf-ib-v'; e.textContent = 'x'; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) e.setAttribute(k, v); return e; }; const valid = mk('a', { href: '#', interestfor: 'cf-ib-target-c' }); const bad = [mk('a', { href: '#' }), mk('a', { href: '#', interestfor: 'cf-ib-no-such-id' }), mk('a', { interestfor: 'cf-ib-target-c' }), mk('button', { interestfor: 'cf-ib-target-c', disabled: '' })]; document.head.append(s); document.body.append(t, valid, ...bad); const g = (e) => /px$/.test(getComputedStyle(e, '::interest-button').width); const r = g(valid) && bad.every((e) => !g(e)); s.remove(); t.remove(); valid.remove(); bad.forEach((e) => e.remove()); return r; })()

assertions.description: The UA stylesheet gives [interestfor]::interest-button a 24px minimum inline size and cursor: help (Chromium html.css, explainer 'The ::interest-button pseudo element').
assertions.test: (() => { const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-target-d'; t.popover = 'hint'; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; a.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-target-d'); a.textContent = 'x'; document.body.append(t, a); const cs = getComputedStyle(a, '::interest-button'); const r = cs.minInlineSize === '24px' && cs.cursor === 'help'; t.remove(); a.remove(); return r; })()

assertions.description: Tapping or clicking the generated ::interest-button shows interest in the originating element immediately (fires 'interest' at the target and opens a popover target) without navigating the originating link.
assertions.test: Needs trusted pointer or touch input on the pseudo-element's box, which script cannot synthesise. Verify on /v141/the-interest-button-pseudo-element/tap-for-hovercard/ with the HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo flag on: the log shows INTEREST then 'did NOT navigate'.

assertions.description: ::interest-button is not focusable (no extra Tab stop) and is not exposed in the accessibility tree, because all of its information is already on the originating element.
assertions.test: Needs the DevTools accessibility pane or a screen reader. The generation-rules concept's Tab trace shows that no focus stop lands on the box.
